rules.source_section: INDICATIONS FOR UPPER EXTREMITY MAGNETIC RESONANCE ANGIOGRAPHY (MRA) / Special Notes
rules.source_quote: When a separate MRA and MRI exam is requested, documentation requires a medical reason

criteria.description: Evaluation of known or suspected upper extremity vascular disease when CTA is contraindicated or cannot be performed (e.g. iodinated contrast allergy or renal insufficiency)

required_documentation: Clinical notes detailing vascular compromise and medical reason why CTA cannot be performed
rules.review_notes: Upper extremity MRA indicated when CTA is contraindicated or additional soft tissue vascular clarification is needed.
